desc:
⚔️ Welcome to Army Evolution! From banana-throwing monkeys to roaring tanks, lead your army through the ages!

🤝 Fight solo or team up with friends in squads of up to 4 players!
🪖 Recruit and upgrade troops, mix unit types, and break through enemy defenses!
🏰 Build defensive towers, protect your base, and manage supplies. Choose when to attack and when to evolve!
🔥 Take on Normal, Hard, and Hell difficulties to unlock more powerful eras!
🏆 Destroy the enemy base, beat your best clear time, and climb the global leaderboards!

🧠 Know your troop counters!
• Infantry counters Support.
• Support counters Anti-Armor.
• Anti-Armor counters Armored.
• Armored counters Infantry.

Deal bonus damage and take 50% less damage from the troop type you counter! These advantages apply only to troops, not towers or bases.

Your army. Your command!
